original_test_intent: Validate DCGM discovery and health handling for approved graphics processes while correlating every reported context with its PID, owner, container and workload and avoiding impact to unapproved jobs.
original_method: Inventory GPU processes with PID/owner/container, memory/utilization and approved workload map; preserve logs; define isolation and termination prohibition; establish service/persistence in supported order; run one full monitored level-4 diagnostic; correlate process-specific subtests and verify all original approved contexts remain healthy or end only as planned.
manual_activity: Workload owners identify every permitted graphics context and authorize isolation; lab operator controls DCGM state changes and response to process or tenant impact.
required_inputs: Approved workload isolation and termination policy
OOB, monitoring, privacy and recovery controls
safety_requirements: Do not terminate or expose unapproved tenant contexts
Retain complete diagnostic and process inventory
Restore approved state and do not auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify ownership, isolation and diagnostic approval
Verify contexts/final state and report without verdict
engineer_actions: Approve process inventory and handling policy

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It invokes the suite without process identity/ownership controls, truncates the needed evidence and uses unsafe SSH plus a conflicting level.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use authenticated access, start DCGM first, capture authorized process inventories before/after and retain all level-4 process-related results.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Persistence setting, level 4, 120-minute allocation and error-free diagnostic criterion remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind each graphics context to GPU, PID, owner/container and declared workload before correlating it with diagnostic subtests and post-run survival.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds tenancy/privacy, process ownership, no-termination boundary and before/after correlation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A generic DCGM PASS cannot establish correct discovery or safe handling of graphics processes.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Diagnostics can conflict with live contexts, expose tenant metadata or interrupt workloads.

project_override_considerations: Workload governance must define whether the expected state is zero graphics processes or a specific allowlist and which identifiers may be retained in evidence.
expected_evidence: Complete level-4 process-related subtests and exits
No unapproved impact, restored state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Service start is ordered after the diagnostic, DeepSeek asks for level-1 evidence instead of source level 4, and the generic source body supplies no graphics-process-specific oracle despite the title.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; execution blocks if process ownership/isolation, diagnostic impact, supported order, privacy or recovery cannot be established.

review_improvement: Makes graphics-process coverage attributable to authorized live contexts and prevents a diagnostic success from hiding workload loss.
